title: Board pick writer must not bypass governance brake into validated

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Implementation commit containing the shared automated write boundary, board/scanner pre-write freshness checks, submission-service integration, and focused regression coverage.
sha_binding.rebase_note: The branch rebased cleanly from 4707c0ce onto 88c9a59e after local verification because origin/main advanced before publication; 66c4cfd1 is the rewritten exact implementation-and-test source commit.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced static and in-memory runtime evidence. Writable database verification remains delegated to the staging-ci GitHub environment and this bundle does not claim PM approval or production certification.

does_not_claim: No Supabase project was mutated by this lane.

implemented_boundary.classification: board-construction or system-pick-scanner source with metadata.systemGenerated=true
implemented_boundary.shared_enforcement_point: apps/api/src/submission-service.ts calls prepareAutomatedSubmission before idempotency lookup and persistence
implemented_boundary.atomicity: The requested initial lifecycle state is supplied to createCanonicalPickFromSubmission and persisted with the pick and birth lifecycle event; no validated-to-awaiting transition is used.
implemented_boundary.approval_dimension_note: approval_status remains separate from picks.status; lifecycle awaiting_approval is the operator-review gate.
implemented_boundary.freshness_posture: market-universe identity, provider market key, snapshot timestamp, provider key, and current freshness are required before any automated submission write.
implemented_boundary.provenance: metadata.automatedWriteBoundary records producer, source, source snapshot time and age, transition actor, transition reason, and required state; the birth lifecycle event uses the same actor role and reason.
implemented_boundary.human_path_preserved: Non-system-generated submissions, including operator board-construction submissions, retain the existing validated initial state.
implemented_boundary.readiness_signal: detectAutomatedDirectToValidatedWrite identifies the forbidden automated validated state and submission idempotency checks fail closed when it is observed.

observations: Automated board submissions are born awaiting_approval with boundary and lifecycle provenance.
Automated scanner submissions are born awaiting_approval; the existing governance-brake call observes already_gated and remains idempotent.
Missing or stale source evidence stops both producer loops before submission persistence.
Schedule flags control whether producers execute but cannot turn an automated pick into validated or approved lifecycle state.
The readiness detector reports a system-generated board/scanner pick observed in validated.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Every automated board/scanner pick enters awaiting_approval without a transient validated state.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Shared submission boundary selects awaiting_approval as the initial state and focused submission/producer tests assert the persisted pick and birth lifecycle event.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Scheduler and enablement flags decide execution only and cannot approve an automated write.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Board writer tests exercise enabled and override execution paths and assert awaiting_approval; submission-service enforcement is independent of scheduler flags.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Missing or stale evidence fails before write.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Boundary tests reject missing/stale evidence, while board/scanner tests verify missing re-reads and stale snapshots produce no submission.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Record producer provenance, transition actor, and reason.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: automatedWriteBoundary metadata and the birth lifecycle event record the producer-derived actor and explicit operator-approval reason.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Readiness can mechanically detect any direct automated validated write.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: detectAutomatedDirectToValidatedWrite and assertNoAutomatedDirectToValidatedWrite have positive and negative coverage and guard idempotent legacy observations.
Classification requires systemGenerated=true and a focused test confirms a manual board-construction submission remains validated.
